Thanks Rishi — appreciate the recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- Data residency and logging sound fine, please ensure logs are retained for no more than 90 days unless flagged by our ops team.
- Training: Acme requires that any production customer transcripts, messages, or other PII data not be used to train or improve publicly shared models or Redwood's model improvement pipelines. We are comfortable with anonymized telemetry for operational improvements (e.g., perf/latency), but not for model training.

Legal (cc'd) — do you need a formal addendum? If so, please advise the language (we'd prefer a short clause).

Alex / Rishi — thanks for the ping. Confirming we can meet Acme's request. Implementation and legal notes below: 

Platform / engineering controls (summary):
- Tenant-level opt-out: We will apply a tenant metadata flag (no_training=true) at the ingestion boundary. Flagged data is excluded from all model training pipelines, including offline retraining, fine-tuning, and any human annotation queues.
- Human review: No customer data will be routed to human labelers when flag is set.
- Logging & retention: Request/response logs will be captured for debugging only, stored in an isolated bucket in us-west, and subject to a 90-day retention policy unless Acme requests otherwise.
- Verification: We'll provide a one-time export showing the tenant flag and policy configuration, and include an internal audit log snippet demonstrating exclusion from an example training job.

Contractual language (suggested one-paragraph addendum):
"Customer Data Opt-Out for Model Improvement. Customer may elect in writing to exclude its Customer Data from Redwood Inference's model improvement, training, or human review processes. Redwood will tag Customer Data with a no_training flag and will exclude such tagged data from any model training pipelines, human annotation queues, and public model datasets. Logging for operational debugging may still occur and will be subject to the retention period specified in the Agreement."

Next steps: 
1) If this wording looks good, we can prepare a short addendum and send via DocuSign.
2) We'll run the tenant flag change in staging and provide the verification export prior to go-live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood-inference.com
